_readme: NOTHING IS BOUND HERE ON PURPOSE. Bind your rig in NCM's WHEEL panel: each role has a device and an
axis dropdown, and a live percentage beside it so you can press a pedal and see which axis moves.
The plugin writes your choices back into this file, so the panel is the source of truth and this is
its record -- you should not need to edit it by hand.
A wheel is adopted automatically because it reports itself as a DirectInput driving device. Pedals
are never adopted automatically: a pedal set and a gamepad look identical to enumeration, and a wrong
guess means a controller lying on a desk holds your throttle open.
`device` is a VID:PID key such as "044F:B371". It survives a replug, unlike a DirectInput instance
GUID, which is reassigned between sessions. Run ncm_rig_devices.exe to list what is attached.
`deviceClass` sets the force ceiling and is a SAFETY setting: gear 0.24, belt 0.20, direct_drive 0.06,
unknown 0.04. It defaults to unknown, the lowest, because an unidentified wheel is assumed to be the
most powerful thing it could be. Raise it only to match the wheel you actually own.
